id-mule-vs-wt.front: Which deer is which? Name the clues.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 556" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Mule deer and white tailed deer compared. Antlers, side view: the mule deer antler forks, and each fork forks again, a "Y" on a "Y". The white tail antler has one main beam that sweeps forward, with single tines rising up from it. Tail and rump seen from behind: the mule deer has a big white rump patch and a thin white tail with a black tip. The white tail has a wide brown tail, white below, which it waves up as a white flag when it runs.">

id-mule-vs-wt.back: Left: mule deer. Forked antlers, big ears, thin white tail with a black tip, big white rump. Right: white tailed deer. One main beam with single tines, wide brown tail flagged white when alarmed.

id-stot.front: A deer bounces away on all 4 feet at once. Which species?
id-stot.back: Mule deer. The bounce is called stotting. White tails gallop with the tail up.
